'''Kotokai''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the<ref name="LECG" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nagi/Legends|Nagi]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kotokai was mentioned in the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2009]].<ref name="LECG" />
